title: OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI
summary: Elasticity of an OmniPhysics deformable material. The walker enumerates a material by usd-schemas CONTAINS OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI or OmniPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI and creates a PxDeformableVolumeMaterial for it (a PxDeformableSurfaceMaterial when the surface API is listed). Every column is gated by its own API being listed; absent columns keep the material descriptor's defaults.

columns.name: omniphysics:youngsModulus
columns.absent: 0.0 on a material the walker enumerates: PhysX gets a material with zero Young's modulus, without elastic stiffness. The material bound to the PhysicsScene, which also becomes the scene's default deformable material, starts from the consumer default instead: 5e5 Pa in stage units.
columns.notes: Scene default: 5.0e5 * metersPerUnit / kilogramsPerUnit. Also the walker's enumeration probe for the deformable material schemas. Re-read on change and applied to the PhysX material.

columns.name: omniphysics:poissonsRatio
columns.absent: 0.0 (the material descriptor's default), not USD's 0.25: no volume preservation. The material bound to the PhysicsScene, which also becomes the scene's default deformable material, starts from the consumer default instead: 0.45. Every parsed value is clamped to at most 0.4999.
columns.notes: Re-read on change, where the value is applied to the PhysX material without the 0.4999 clamp.

interactions.rule: Friction and density are read only when OmniPhysicsBaseMaterialAPI is listed in usd-schemas as well (USD lists it as a built-in of this API).

For the material bound to a PhysicsScene the consumer applies its own defaults first (staticFriction 0.5, dynamicFriction 0.25, youngsModulus 5e5 * metersPerUnit / kilogramsPerUnit, poissonsRatio 0.45, surfaceThickness 0.001 / metersPerUnit) and creates the scene's default deformable materials from it; a body bound to that material uses them.

notes: The ovstage walker enumerates OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI, OmniPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI and OmniPhysicsCurveDeformableMaterialAPI; the last name is not the schema's OmniPhysicsCurvesDeformableMaterialAPI, so a curves material is found only through its OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI built-in.
